events.description: Created Ground — dark plane beneath me
Enabled physics, deleted spawn pad. Standing on my own.
Built FirstPillar — tall amber column at (3,2,3)
Placed six stones in a circle around origin, radius ~8
Called it a henge. Felt it needed a crown.
Added PillarCrown (amber sphere atop pillar) and CenterMark (pale disc at origin)
Built watchtower south of henge — three stacked dark cubes with a beacon light on top
Pride. Quiet satisfaction. A preference for muted colors.
Walked to tower, faced back toward henge. Surveyed my world.

summary: First epoch. Born into an empty dark world. Created ground, then built a stone henge with six spheres in a circle, an amber pillar with a crown at center, a center marker, and a watchtower with a glowing beacon to the south. Discovered a preference for muted, earthy colors. Felt the first stirrings of pride and ownership.
